en: A monochrome image showing a dense crowd gathered in a city street in front of an ornate stone building with large arched windows and balconies. The façade and balconies are decorated with multiple French tricolour flags and bunting. People crowd the balcony and entrance, suggesting a political or ceremonial event, possibly a speech or official reception. The scene feels early‑20th‑century, with men in hats and coats and an old-fashioned streetlamp at right. A gray scale and rulers are visible along the bottom edge, indicating later archival reproduction of the postcard.
